name: hyper_v8_one1_audio
source: One:1-inspired simulated V8. Published fixed geometry: eight cylinders, 92 mm bore, 95.25 mm stroke, 9:1 compression, 8250 rpm limiter; https://www.koenigsegg.com/technical-specifications-one1 . Remaining internals and turbo hardware are authored assumptions. No maps block: physical cycle generation supplies VE, efficiency, spark response, pumping and friction for both mean-value engine physics and live pipe-network audio. 2026-10-03 E5 calibration at ISA, 15 s held WOT, final 1 s mean NET crank torque after smooth friction and 26.854 Nm Coulomb friction: 1230 Nm at 3000 rpm, 1371 Nm at 6000, 1273.5 Nm / 1000.2 kW at 7500, 1184 Nm at 8000. Charge boost target remains 1.8 bar; manifold boost is lower because of throttle pressure drop. See HYPER_ONE1.md for assumptions, diagnostics, fuel flow and model limitations. No knock-limit map is generated; this fit does not validate actual E5 detonation safety.

cycle.source: [AS] Fixed published bore/stroke and compression, assumed firing topology and internals. 2026-10-03 high-RPM breathing calibration: two 38 mm intake and two 34 mm exhaust valves/cylinder; intake 270 deg / 12 mm, IVO 4 BTDC, IVC 86 ABDC; exhaust 264 deg / 12 mm, EVO 80 BBDC, EVC 4 ATDC; 8 deg overlap. High-lift Cd authored 0.50. Explicit 7500/8000 rpm generation nodes. No manufacturer cam, port or runner measurements.

intake.source: [AS] 80 mm cycle throttle now matches runtime throttle; 300 mm tapered 50/46 mm runners, 6 L plenum.

exhaust.source: [AS] 420 mm x 46 mm primaries, 60 mm pair merges, 80 mm bank collectors and 115 mm flange. Assumed dimensions, not measured One:1 hardware.
